_about: Significant disasters from Wikipedia's lists (deadliest tropical cyclones, costliest Atlantic hurricanes, deadliest floods, wildfires, landslides, avalanches, heat waves, droughts, tornado outbreaks, and natural disasters by death toll), each read from its own article's infobox (cited per record). date is the start (a cyclone's formation, a flood's onset); end_date when known; time only for earthquakes with a UTC timestamp. time_confidence month = only the month is known, cast mid-month. A record with same_as names an NCEI earthquake, tsunami or eruption: the server puts its name on that record instead of listing it twice.
